shots.title: The dot
shots.hold: One amber dot breathes at the centre of a dark field.
shots.becomes: Its corners come out as it turns: the dot becomes a square.

shots.title: The square
shots.hold: The coral square stands upright, alone.
shots.becomes: It flattens and sinks into a thin pale rule, where the line will stand.

shots.title: The line
shots.hold: Five words rise onto the rule one by one; the frame keeps pushing in.
